title: Local finite presentation models satisfy the weak Serre clauses
statement: Let X be a scheme and R a commutative Noetherian ring. In the intrinsic category of modules over the constant ring on X_proet, the sheaves having finitely presented constant local models [def-sfb-proetale-fp-local-models] are closed under kernels and cokernels of maps between such sheaves, and the middle object of every short exact sequence whose outer objects have these models also has these models. There is no stratification in this assertion.

proof.text: Transport the sheaves and morphism or short exact sequence through the scalar-and-site equivalence of the comparison lemma. Equivalences preserve kernels, cokernels and short exact sequences. The comparison identifies the hypotheses with finite-type local constancy on the small equivalent site.

Apply the arbitrary-site finite-type locally constant weak Serre theorem. For kernels and cokernels, transport back across the canonical kernel/cokernel preservation isomorphisms. For extensions, apply exactness of the equivalence directly to the short exact sequence. The comparison in the reverse direction gives finitely presented intrinsic local models in each case.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_fp_localModels_serre (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Type u)
    [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    (∀ (F G : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)) (f : F ⟶ G),
      IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule F →
      IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule G →
      IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule (kernel f) ∧
        IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule (cokernel f)) ∧
    (∀ S : ShortComplex (proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)),
      S.ShortExact → IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule S.X₁ →
      IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule S.X₃ →
      IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule S.X₂)
